records.summary: MTSU Policy 256 (articulation with TBR community colleges and state universities; effective June 5, 2017, last reviewed November 2020): no limit on credits transferred from a community college or state university; equivalent Level One courses apply like native courses; an associate degree designed for transfer satisfies all general education, and completed blocks of the common 41-hour general education core satisfy those categories; transfer students must meet Level Two and residency requirements at MTSU; PLA credit from other Tennessee institutions transfers like other credit. The 2026-2027 Psychology handbook states transfer students need a minimum of 50 semester hours of senior college credit for an MTSU degree.

residency_rules.text: A minimum of 50 semester hours of senior college credit is required for a degree from MTSU (as stated for transfer students in the 2026-2027 Psychology Undergraduate Handbook).

records.notes: Policy 256 states no minimum grade, D-grade rule or MTSU residence-hour figure.
